text_block_list.text:
The final day of the "Summer Training Camp."
...There was one worry I couldn't get out of my head.

She had definitely picked it up once. And given the title,
there was no way she could have overlooked it.
Even so, Sirius Symboli showed no particular change in behavior.
choice_data_list: (I hope this is just needless worrying)
(I hope it's just me worrying over nothing)

text_block_list.text:
Looking up—
I saw Sirius Symboli leaning against the window,
listening intently.

Following her lead, I strain my ears.
Suddenly, a faint conversation reaches us from outside the training lodge—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
While recovering, I took the time to properly think
about what it really means to wear two hats.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Huh, *you're* feeling down?
Did cancelling the overseas challenge really hit you that hard?

"The one speaking is Mr. C.B., the Umamusume
who loves freedom more than anyone and who
achieved the Classic Triple Crown two years ago for the first time in over a decade."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: ...Well, one thing led to another.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: "...Until now, I believed both were essential: demonstrating my own ability as an athlete, and supporting everyone as an advisor while organizing the environment."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"Otherwise,
I wouldn't be worthy of guiding others, you see."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
However... the world of racing was vast,
diverse, and profoundly deep.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Enough that my own stature simply wouldn't suffice.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
"Hmm?
You've gotten awfully timid."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"I was able to understand myself.
I consider it a positive change."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
...I should've stuck to just one or the other.
That's what I'm thinking now.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Huh! So you're gonna focus solely
on being an athlete from now on?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: No—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: I'm thinking of shifting my focus to working behind the scenes.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Improving the facilities' environments, expanding overseas ventures, career placement after retiring from the racing world—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: I want to learn such things, broaden my horizons, and strive to elevate the entire Umamusume world.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
............
Are you really going to quit that easily?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: "It is a shame, yes. Though I doubt there's any other peculiar Umamusume willing to do such a thing."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Besides, if it's the other position...
someone will eventually step up to take it.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Right now, I have that kind of conviction.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
"...I see. It's sad, but
if that's how you feel, it can't be helped."

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Still, taking over your position, huh?
I doubt me or Ace could ever pull that off. Ahaha!

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: (...Rudolf is stepping away from the center stage...?)

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: ...Tsk!

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
(Why am I shaken? Isn't never having to see him
preach on the turf again exactly what I wished for?)

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
...Thanks for your concern, puppy.
Though, it was her own decision.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: Ain't got nothing to do with me.

After that, I never spoke of
that matter with Sirius Symboli again.

The potential collapse of the "Summer Sirius Plan,"
and the fact that Symboli Rudolf will step down from the front lines in the near future――

Leaving behind a lingering bitter aftertaste,
the summer training camp came to a close.
